title: Asymptotics of Expanding Vacuum Spacetimes Near Singularities
exact_target: Describe both the approach to the past singularity and the future evolution of expanding vacuum cosmologies with compact CMC slices.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004803 (OWR-8415343-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/40, pp. 2157--2267. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 42.
Lott, initial geometry of vacuum cosmological spacetimes (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Lott, future behavior of expanding spacetimes (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The report discusses the $3+1$-dimensional setting, with some results extending further. No particular rescaled limit, topology or genericity condition is fixed by the extraction; both temporal directions remain in the research target.
